notesStmt.note: As his note in the bottom right corner indicates, Horace Traubel recorded the existence of this particular item during his visit to Whitman on October 28, 1888 (see med.00002.106).
This mock-up represents a late stage of Whitman's work on the title page for Complete Poems & Prose, which he self-published near the end of 1888.
